children: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon will attend U.S. President Donald Trump's state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping, according to a source familiar with the matter on Friday.

Trump will welcome the Chinese leader at the White House next week for their second meeting this year, as the two leaders seek stability in a relationship under pressure over issues ranging from trade to Taiwan and Iran as well as global worries about artificial intelligence.
